wars.name_ar: الحرب الأهلية في جنوب السودان [يحتاج تحقق]
belligerents: SPLM/A in opposition (Riek Machar) and allied forces, incl. White Army
wars.causes: Internal power struggle within the SPLM; fighting began in Juba on 15 Dec 2013 (UNMISS paras 1–2)

cites.pages: para 1: "the 2018 peace deal that ended five years of civil war"

wars.note: End year 2018 per UN News, 27 Mar 2025: "the 2018 peace deal that ended five years of civil war". The same article warns of a 2025 risk of renewed war: "this action takes the country yet one step closer to the edge of a collapse into civil war and the dismantling of the peace agreement" (UN spokesperson), and the Commission on Human Rights in South Sudan warned that failure "will lead to a catastrophic return to war".
wars.note_ar: انتهت الحرب الأهلية بموجب اتفاق السلام لعام 2018 (أخبار الأمم المتحدة، 27 آذار/مارس 2025)، مع تحذير من خطر العودة إلى الحرب في 2025. [يحتاج تحقق]
